title: Ruthenium nanoparticles stabilized by mercaptan and acetylene derivatives with supercapacitor application
author: Guo, Zhang, et al.

steps.title: Dissolve RuCl3 in ethanol
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 20.8 mg RuCl₃ (0.1 mmol) and dissolve it in about 1 mL ethanol to obtain a dark wine‑colored solution.

steps.title: Transfer solution to toluene
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire RuCl₃/ethanol solution into 10 mL toluene, mixing to form a homogeneous mixture.

steps.title: Add ligand and pre‑incubate
steps.instruction: Add either 32 μL phenylacetylene, or 40 μL 2‑phenylethanethiol, or 42 μL 1‑hexanethiol to the mixture and allow the ligands to contact the Ru ions for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add hydrazine hydrate dropwise
steps.instruction: Using a dropping pipet, add 8 mg hydrazine hydrate (≈2‑fold excess relative to RuCl₃) drop by drop to the reaction mixture.

steps.title: Stir reaction
steps.instruction: Stir the reaction mixture for 24 h at ambient temperature to generate organic‑capped Ru nanoparticles.

steps.title: Remove organic solvent
steps.instruction: After 24 h, remove the organic solvents by rotary evaporation.

steps.title: Wash nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Wash the resulting solid several times, first with acetonitrile and then with ethanol, to remove excess ligands.

steps.title: Redissolve in DCM
steps.instruction: Dissolve the purified Ru nanoparticles in dichloromethane (DCM); the solution should appear dark brown or black.
